doc: stages/filters.separatescanline.rst: 'The **Separate scan line Filter** takes a single ``PointView`` as its input and creates a ``PointView`` for each scan line as its output.' and pipeline.rst: 'These writers use a placeholder character (#) in the output filename which is replaced by an incrementing integer for each input point view.' grid.las (PDRF 3) carries EdgeOfFlightLine = 0 on all 1000 points, so there is one scan line and one output file.
